svg.title: Good Company
svg.desc: An engraving-style night scene for Tuesday, 10 November 2026. Matthew and a small robot sit on a hill under a deep-rooted tree, looking up. A shooting star falls across the sky through four stars marked 6.5 s, 1.7 s, 0.24 s and 31 ms, a slider step getting faster over the week, toward a lit town on the far ridge. A string of lanterns runs from the tree to the town.
svg.text: Matthew and his agent, watching a slider’s step fall from seconds to milliseconds · Tuesday, 10 November 2026
